description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests fetching from a remote Git repository using a proxy script, with specific focus on proxy configuration and behavior.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of prerequisite tools or conditions, such as Perl helpers.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting it to succeed, executing the given commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
